result.instructions: Tools for Crowdin, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Crowdin data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run crowdin_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run crowdin_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run crowdin_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. crowdin_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: crowdin_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects the token can access (id, name, sourceLanguageId, targetLanguageIds). Good first call to discover project ids. Crowdin API: GET /projects.

hasManagerAccess.description: 1 = only projects where you are a manager.

tools.name: crowdin_get_project
tools.title: Get project
tools.description: Get a single project's details by id (settings, languages, counts). Crowdin API: GET /projects/{projectId}.

tools.name: crowdin_list_files
tools.title: List files
tools.description: List source files in a project (id, name, path, type, status). Crowdin API: GET /projects/{projectId}/files.

tools.name: crowdin_list_branches
tools.title: List branches
tools.description: List version branches in a project (id, name, title). Crowdin API: GET /projects/{projectId}/branches.

tools.name: crowdin_list_directories
tools.title: List directories
tools.description: List directories (folders) in a project (id, name, path). Crowdin API: GET /projects/{projectId}/directories.

tools.name: crowdin_list_strings
tools.title: List source strings
tools.description: List source strings in a project (id, text, identifier, context). Crowdin API: GET /projects/{projectId}/strings.

croql.description: Crowdin Query Language filter, e.g. count of words <= 5.

filter.description: Filter strings by text or identifier substring.

tools.name: crowdin_get_language_progress
tools.title: Language translation progress
tools.description: Per-target-language translation & approval completion percentages for a project — the headline localization status. Crowdin API: GET /projects/{projectId}/languages/progress.

tools.name: crowdin_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List translation/proofreading tasks in a project (id, title, status, assignees). Crowdin API: GET /projects/{projectId}/tasks.

tools.name: crowdin_list_members
tools.title: List project members
tools.description: List members of a project (id, username, role, permissions). Crowdin API: GET /projects/{projectId}/members.

tools.name: crowdin_list_supported_languages
tools.title: List supported languages
tools.description: Crowdin's catalog of supported languages (id, name, locale, twoLettersCode). Crowdin API: GET /languages.

tools.name: crowdin_add_string
tools.title: Add source string
tools.description: Adds a source string to a file in a Crowdin project (additive). Crowdin API: POST /projects/{projectId}/strings.

fileId.description: Id of the source file to add the string to.

tools.name: crowdin_add_translation
tools.title: Add translation
tools.description: Adds a translation for a source string in a target language (additive). Crowdin API: POST /projects/{projectId}/translations.

stringId.description: Id of the source string to translate.
